query: What constitutes a second property for Workfare Income Supplement (WIS) scheme?
reference_answer: All types of properties e.g. Housing & Development Board flat, private property and non-residential property, are taken into account in determining the eligibility for Workfare Income Supplement (WIS) scheme.
answer: The Workfare Income Supplement (WIS) scheme does not consider a second property as part of its eligibility criteria. [Document 1]
